hdd.label: Heating degree-days
hdd.note: Reference climate roughly like the Colorado Front Range (NOAA 1991-2020 normals range 5,500-7,500 for the region).

psh.label: Peak sun hours
psh.note: NREL NSRDB annual average for the interior West is ~5-6.

pvDerate.label: PV system derate
pvDerate.note: Wiring, inverter, heat, and dust losses (NREL PVWatts default ~0.86; 0.80 is conservative off-grid).

galPerSqftIn.label: Gallons per sq ft per inch of rain
galPerSqftIn.note: Physical constant: 1 inch on 1 sq ft = 0.623 gal.

windCf.label: Small wind capacity factor
windCf.note: Typical small-turbine range 0.10-0.25 depending on site.

hydroCf.label: Micro-hydro capacity factor
hydroCf.note: Year-round stream with a steady head.

periods.meaning: Once per growing season; averaged over the year.
Once a year; averaged over the year.
Setup material; not a recurring flow. Counted in setup, not weekly totals.
A stock that is occupied, not used up (sq ft, gallons of tank, kWh of battery). Weekly factor is 1 so capacities compare directly.

systems.name: Clothesline

systems.notes: Saves about 1 kWh per person a week of dryer power (engine modifier, catalog_overrides.json).
